core: Both communities run a mid-task ablation on the agent's retained scratchpad/notes: at a checkpoint after some progress or information has already accumulated but before the final output/synthesis stage, the notes are deliberately wiped or replaced with a degraded rewrite, so researchers can isolate how much final-task performance depends on the specific retained content rather than on the model's raw reasoning ability.
quote_1: wiped the scratchpad at three checkpoints to measure how much of the performance was sitting in accumulated notes
quote_2: ⟦T2⟧ replaced the retained repair plan after the corrupted row had been encountered but before final export.
